m: शिग्रु m. (of unknown derivation) Moringa Pterygosperma (a kind of horse-radish = शोभाञ्जन; the root and leaves and flowers are eaten), Yājñ.; Suśr. &c.
N. of a man g. बिदादि
pl. N. of a people, RV.
शिग्रु n. the seed of the above tree, Kauś.; Car.
